task.description: Write test/specs/REQ-039.md and test code for REQ-039's implementation (branch feature/WF02-REQ039-20260817). This has real application-executable surface (two new .ex modules, real GenServer/SQL logic) -- full test-design procedure applies, not the docs-only skip. IMPORTANT: ELIXIR-DEV's own handoff (handoffs/WF02-REQ039-20260817/step-02a-elixir-dev.json) flagged a load-bearing test-infrastructure note -- claim/1 calls Ecto.Migrator.run/4 internally, which cannot run under Ecto.Adapters.SQL.Sandbox's default shared-connection mode. Any test exercising claim/1 needs Ecto.Adapters.SQL.Sandbox.mode(Letflow.Repo, :auto) + manual on_exit/1 cleanup, the same pattern test/letflow/tenant_provisioning_test.exs's replay_migrations/2 describe block already established -- read that file's moduledoc and that describe block directly before writing tests, don't rediscover this the hard way.
acceptance_criteria: claim/1 against an empty pool immediately succeeds and returns a sandbox_id + schema_name for a real, freshly-created Postgres schema
claim/1 when max_concurrent_sandboxes slots are all in use blocks until either a slot frees or the wait window elapses, returning SandboxUnavailable in the latter case
release/1 on a claimed sandbox drops its schema (verified: the schema no longer appears in information_schema.schemata after release) and frees its quota slot for a subsequent claim/1
load_fixtures_only/3 with a table_name not in the allowlist returns InvalidTableName without issuing any SQL against that table name
load_fixtures_only/3 loading the same fixtures twice against the same sandbox_schema (simulating a retry) leaves the same final row set both times, via the TRUNCATE-before-insert step

the moduledoc names the process-per-instance-vs-row-based-state open question explicitly and states it is left for CODE-DESIGNER, per this requirement's description and stage-2-event-store-definitions.md's Early findings

result.summary: Wrote test/specs/REQ-039.md and two new ExUnit test files covering all 6 of REQ-039's acceptance criteria: test/letflow/sandbox_pool_test.exs (AC1 claim/1,2 against an empty pool -- real schema confirmed via information_schema.schemata, already-migrated per INV-SP-3; AC2 quota-exhausted blocking -- BOTH the slot-frees-and-waiter-succeeds path, synchronized via bounded :sys.get_state/1 polling of the pool's :waiting queue rather than a fixed sleep, AND the real timeout-to-{:error,:sandbox_unavailable} path with a small 150ms wait window, plus the max_wait_ms<=0 immediate-reject edge; AC3 release/1,2 -- real DROP SCHEMA confirmed via information_schema.schemata, freed slot immediately reclaimable, unknown-id {:error,:not_found}) and test/letflow/sandbox_pool/fixture_loader_test.exs (AC4 allowlist rejection -- whole-batch pre-validation confirmed by checking zero rows landed in the allowlisted table too, plus the schema-name-shape guard INV-FL-1; AC5 idempotent TRUNCATE-before-insert retry -- identical fixtures loaded twice compared via a real SELECT of the row set both times, a changed-content retry proving the prior load's row is genuinely gone not just joined, and an empty-list no-op). AC6 (moduledoc open-question content) is a documentation-content criterion verified by direct inspection of lib/letflow/sandbox_pool.ex lines 13-30, matching REQ-022 AC4 / REQ-020 AC5 precedent -- no runtime test manufactured for it, recorded explicitly in the spec. Per the dispatching task's critical infrastructure note, both new test files reuse tenant_provisioning_test.exs's established Sandbox :auto-mode + manual on_exit cleanup pattern (claim/1,2 calls Ecto.Migrator.run/4 internally, which cannot run under the default shared-connection sandbox mode) and are async: false for the identical reason. Per design doc INV-SP-7, both files start their own uniquely-named SandboxPool instance per test rather than mutating config/test.exs's global singleton (max_concurrent_sandboxes: 1), avoiding any cross-test quota contention. Both files compile cleanly (mix compile --warnings-as-errors, exit 0) and are mix format-clean. Ran both new files in isolation 5 times consecutively (fixed seeds 0/1/2 plus 2 randomized-order runs): 13/13 passed every time, 65/65 total. Verified zero orphan Postgres schema residue via a direct information_schema.schemata query after the final run (one earlier ad hoc run during drafting surfaced 2 orphan schemas from unrelated pre-existing debris in the shared test DB, dropped manually before the 5-run verification sequence -- not reproduced across any of those 5 clean runs, ruling out a leak in this file's own cleanup). Did not run the full suite (test/letflow/sandbox_pool_test.exs and fixture_loader_test.exs only) -- a full-suite run is TEST-RUNNER's Step 4, per this handoff's own task instruction.
